Audit log takes default umask permissions while sibling hook state uses 0600

findingDetails.title: Credential-bearing URLs pass the dispatch audit scrubber unredacted
findingDetails.case: A dispatch line carries proxy credentials or a --base-url with userinfo; the password reaches .skilled/logs/cli-dispatch-audit.log in cleartext and outlives the turn.
findingDetails.scopeProof: SECRET_PATTERNS read at 1106-1135; the assignment pattern at 1116 keys on the variable name so HTTPS_PROXY never matches; a live probe of buildAuditLine returned LEAK for both URL userinfo forms and REDACTED for --api-key, --access-token, Bearer and PEM.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Log directory is gitignored and the operator must embed credentials in the command.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The scrubber targets accidental env-injected secrets, not deliberate URL credentials.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Credential-bearing URLs unreachable through the shipped adapters' command sources.

findingDetails.title: Audit log takes default umask permissions while sibling hook state uses 0600
findingDetails.case: Two local accounts share a checkout; the audit log holds up to 500 characters of every dispatch command and is readable by the second account because it was created 0644.
findingDetails.scopeProof: appendFileSync at 1243 passes no mode and mkdirSync at 1234 none either; .skilled/logs/completion-sentinel-advisories.log is -rw-r--r-- under this umask; capture-core.mjs:370 sets 0o600 for the analogous queue.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Directory is gitignored and normally single-user; content is scrubbed for named shapes.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Repo-local logs may be treated as private by convention.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A deployment that creates .skilled/logs with mode 0700.

results.summary: D1 and D2 hold for the cores read; the audit library's own never-on-disk claim and its file mode do not match the code.

noveltyJustification: Two new security findings, both first raised in this lineage and neither refining an earlier finding. Ratio is 2 new P2 over 4 total weighted P2 (2 carried, 2 new).

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Security review of shared hook cores that every runtime adapter imports, not a trivial single-file change.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Strategy Next Focus named these trust boundaries; each is imported by many runtime adapters, so a defect here reaches every runtime.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The audit scrubber removes every secret shape that can appear in a dispatch command.

searchActions.result: --api-key, --access-token, Bearer and PEM redacted; proxy URL and --base-url userinfo leaked

searchLedger.rationale: URL userinfo has no anchoring pattern, so the password reaches the log.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The audit log is created no more permissively than the sibling decision queue.

searchActions.result: no mode on the audit write; sibling uses 0600; existing sibling log is 0644

searchLedger.rationale: The writer omits a mode while the analogous writer sets one.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A file kill-switch can override an explicit environment value.

searchActions.result: environment value wins per key, including blank; aliases are additive

searchLedger.rationale: Precedence matches the documented per-key contract.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: resolve() is environment-first for the same key.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A host that streams or never closes stdin can hold a hook open or exhaust memory.

searchActions.result: 22/22 pass; cap settles to empty string and the 3s deadline fires

searchLedger.rationale: Cap and deadline both settle; the 64 MiB bound is intentional.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Bounded by MAX_STDIN_BYTES plus the deadline timer.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An adapter persists raw prompt or command text containing a secret.

searchActions.queryOrPath: write/append/JSON.stringify over the three adapter families
searchActions.result: only capture-core and the guard write; queue is 0600, warning details name agents and counts only, dsh completion writes nothing

searchLedger.rationale: No write path carries raw prompt text.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Read every write site in the three families.
